result.title: When Should an LLM Steering Edit Depend on the Input?
result.summary: An activation steering edit should depend on the input exactly when the destination varies \emph{inside} the class a query requests, and that is measurable before any rule is fitted or applied. Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) adds one fixed direction to every input, the difference of the class means. Conditioning it on the requested class accounts for the between-class variation in the required displacement and leaves the within-class variation untouched, which no rule that reads only the source state can express. We study the impact of increasing input-dependence in the steering edit, moving from a difference of means to a destination retrieved per query --- the mean of the $k$ stored states nearest the query, inside the requested class --- in which the two baselines are endpoints: at $k$ equal to the class size the retrieved rule \emph{is} the class-conditional difference of means. We measure input-dependent steering on six substitution corpora that vary in whether the edit changes a word or a clause, and on an external benchmark, and find that input-dependent steering outperforms fixed-direction steering when the destination varies within the class. Retrieval wins at every layer of every substitution corpus in two models, and the level of input-dependence needed governs how to apply it: word-level edits are best made in the first tenth of the network from a few neighbours, clause-level edits at any depth from the class mean. Where the class already determines the answer the class mean suffices and retrieval only matches it, though a fixed direction still fails there. Four quantities computed from the states alone identify the regime in which the edit should be applied.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 激活引导编辑何时应依赖输入：把 Contrastive Activation Addition 的固定方向扩展为按查询在类内检索 k 个近邻状态得到目标，在六个替换语料与一个外部基准上比较层深与输入依赖程度，并用仅由状态算出的四个量判定适用区间。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“按查询检索状态目标 + 由状态统计量判定干预区间与深度”的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态应逐输入更新还是固定、在何处施加干预提供可核查的方法线索，但原文为纯文本转向任务，尚无视觉证据相关验证。
